_about: HBARXFER class -- board-mode proposal-and-sign HBAR transfer, end-to-end. Born directly from a live user test (feedback session delta-sierra-46, 2026-07-16): a real testnet HBAR offer, locked, signed via WalletConnect, executed, landed in the recipient's store. User: 'if that's something we can set up as a stand automated test, this is also a demo of that.' Key requirement: automated runs use a SMALL testnet amount (0.01 ℏ), not 1 ℏ -- there's no reason to spend more on a repeatable check.
title: Board proposal: offer HBAR, lock, sign via WalletConnect, execute, verify landing

hard_assertions: kflow board:sign:click fires for the signing account
kdiag board:txsocket:update sequence includes signature_added then tx_receipt (hasReceipt:true)
the transferred amount now appears in the recipient's STORE zone (a new store chip for the asset)
the recipient's segment gains a 🧪 zone-walls entry if it had none before (BOARD-ZONEWALLSEMPTY1 -- store zone was empty pre-transfer)
board:signstatus.unassocAccts stays empty for a plain HBAR transfer (no association required)
kflow events on both the sender and recipient tabs share the SAME game id (post KFLOW-gameOf fix, 2026-07-16) -- the multi-browser correlation the user asked for
oracle.trace_shape: board:sign:click -> board:signstatus(pending) -> board:txsocket:update(signature_added) -> board:signstatus(signed) -> board:txsocket:update(tx_receipt, hasReceipt:true) -> board:result:shown(ok:true)
oracle.benchmark: the user's own live run, session delta-sierra-46 (2026-07-16 19:16-19:20, testnet, txid 0.0.1532@1784229438.829000000, 1 ℏ, t-prop) -- kdiag/kflow trace archived in logs/kflow + logs/kdiag on lab1 for that window; screenshots not captured (recorded via feedback session, not the qa/results.html recorder)

network.note: mainnet excluded from automation on principle -- real value, no reason to spend it on a repeatable check

amount.name: transfer amount
amount.note: USER REQUIREMENT (2026-07-16): automated runs must use a SMALL amount, not the 1 ℏ used in the manual demo -- 0.01 ℏ is plenty to prove the pipeline and costs near nothing repeated

target.name: target account state
target.note: empty-store is the interesting case -- exercises BOARD-ZONEWALLSEMPTY1's boundary and proves the chip has somewhere to land even with no prior wall drawn

pairwise_target: n/a -- small enough to run exhaustively once automatable

instances.why_manual: signing requires a real WalletConnect wallet -- automation blocked on QA-WCTEST1's headless virtual-wallet bot, not yet wired

fixtures.manual: any live board on lab1 (or alpha), a testnet account with a paired wallet; feedback-session recorder (long-press -> Start session) captures the kdiag/kflow trace automatically
fixtures.auto: BLOCKED on QA-WCTEST1 (headless WalletConnect virtual-wallet bot: pair from the WC URI, auto-approve, auto-sign). Once that lands, this class runs the same steps end-to-end with no human: create/join game -> offer 0.01 ℏ -> lock -> strike -> bot wallet signs -> assert the oracle sequence above. Ties into TESTLOOP1/KATRUN1 the same way katrun's other scenarios do.
